title.rendered: Yves Gallard Completes a Chromatic Wall at Ajuinlei in Ghent

excerpt.rendered: Yves Gallard has completed a new wall at Ajuinlei in Ghent, Belgium, invited by the local street-art organisation Wallin’. Positioned beside one of the city’s waterways, the mural extends Gallard’s ongoing interest in what he describes as “chromatic vibration” within the urban landscape. title.rendered: Scaf Paints for Southend City Jam 2026 in Southend-on-Sea

excerpt.rendered: French artist Scaf has painted a new work for Southend City Jam 2026, the fifth edition of Southend-on-Sea’s annual street-art festival. The artist’s contribution is located at Alexandra Street Car Park, close to the city centre.
